title: Lightly Grilled Syrian Melon Kebabs
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring melons, this recipe is a tangy and gooey hangover cure, made with low-calorie-friendly ingredients and grilled to perfection in a tandoor.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor or grill to medium heat.
Thread the diced melons onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and sumac.
Brush the mixture onto the melon kebabs, making sure they are evenly coated.
Grill the kebabs for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they are lightly charred.
Serve the kebabs hot, with toasted pita bread on the side.
Drizzle any remaining lemon juice mixture over the kebabs before serving.
Garnish with additional sumac and black pepper, if desired.
